lead: Frank Caprio was an American lawyer, born on 23 November 1936 in Federal Hill.
He died on 20 August 2025 in Providence at the age of 88.
He has held the office of Chief Judge of the Providence Municipal Court.
Below you will find a verified overview of Frank Caprio: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
